question: Can an explicit causal mixture between persistence and the frozen dynamic update repair low-activity rollout errors?

causal_matrix.hard_hurdle_instantaneous: binary gate from raw delta, current voltage and baseline delta
causal_matrix.hard_hurdle_temporal: binary gate adding fast/slow EMA and predicted displacement
causal_matrix.soft_blend_instantaneous: continuous convex blend from instantaneous causal features
causal_matrix.soft_blend_temporal: continuous convex blend adding causal temporal features

oracles.teacher_regime_oracle: future teacher activity selects persistence below 1 mV and dynamic update otherwise
oracles.teacher_optimal_blend_oracle: future teacher endpoint selects the per-step optimal convex blend

terminal_decision_rule.any_causal_gate_passes: revise architecture with a persistence-dynamic gate
terminal_decision_rule.teacher_regime_oracle_only_passes: revise architecture with an explicit regime-state encoder
terminal_decision_rule.optimal_blend_oracle_only_passes: revise architecture with a continuous mixture state
terminal_decision_rule.no_oracle_passes: replace or extend the voltage expert family
